senses.gloss:
I. 1 P. (केतति) 
__1 To desire. 
__2 To live. 
__3 (चिकित्सति) To heal, cure. 
__4 To doubt, suspect. --II. 3 P. Ved. (चिकित्ति) To know.

(-वी f.) 
__1 A rogue, liar, cheat; अर्हति किल कितव उपद्रवम् [[M. 4]]; [[Amaru. 20]], 46; [[Me. 113.]] 
__2 The Dhattūra plant. 
__3 A kind of perfume (commonly रोचन). 
__4 A gamester, gambler; [[Ms. 3. 159.]] 
__5 A mad or crazy person.
f. N. of a plant (Mar. ज्येष्ठमध).
